summary.tldr: Lets former employees file workplace harassment and violence complaints for longer after they leave a federally regulated job.
what_it_does: Extends an employer’s duties for workplace harassment and violence if the employer learns of the occurrence within two years after the former employee leaves.
Lets a former employee make a complaint about workplace harassment and violence under the Canada Labour Code.
Treats the former employee as an employee for the parts of the complaint process needed to finish the case.
Sets the complaint deadline at the later of two years after leaving the job, or two years after the resolution process ends if notice was given under the regulations.
summary.background: The bill amends the Canada Labour Code rules on workplace harassment and violence complaints by former employees.
